change_reason: Final pre-forward source-admission hardening before any genuine forward rule exists: freeze canonical source identity, immutable admission_class, high-confidence late-discovery veto, single-source Evidence Foundation start, and EventScore-level genuine-forward admission. No Promotion, FDR, family, author, MAE, price-source, concentration, or maturity threshold is changed.

definitions.feature_cutoff: strictly_before_decision_timestamp; daily market context uses prior completed close

clustering.author_independence: unique author count within each rule family, reported separately from effective sample size
clustering.time_cluster_definition: For a declared horizon, each mature event contributes [baseline_date, horizon_end_date]. Any directly or transitively overlapping intervals form one cluster. Distinct clusters must be pairwise non-overlapping.
clustering.horizon_end_source: exact realized horizon_end_date carried by EventScore from the source outcome; missing/invalid end dates are not counted as independent evidence
clustering.bootstrap_block: resample complete overlap-connected time clusters; all symbols/events in a cluster move together

multiple_testing.hypothesis_family: all active rule_family x all declared horizons under the frozen family definition, whether currently testable or not
multiple_testing.pvalue_method: cluster sign-flip null on overlap-connected time-cluster means

price_source_policy.conflict_policy: mark invalid/conflict and do not score

scoring_engine_identity.consumer_rule: statistical consumers operate on one current effective record per event_id under the active spec; append-only historical revisions are audit/provenance only

instrument_diagnostics.note: Instrument-class diagnostics do not create or merge Rule Families and cannot relax Promotion.

point_in_time_eligibility.authoritative_clock: Source Store first_fetched_at only; published_at is diagnostic and can never make evidence earlier
point_in_time_eligibility.baseline_timestamp_semantics: baseline_date US regular-session open 09:30 America/New_York converted to UTC; for daily OHLC planned-touch events this is intentionally conservative and requires the source to have been fetched before that session opened
point_in_time_eligibility.timezone_policy: both timestamps must parse as timezone-aware instants; unknown/naive first_fetched_at is not eligible
point_in_time_eligibility.unknown_source_timezone_policy: published_at remains diagnostic only; eligibility still uses first_fetched_at
point_in_time_eligibility.backfill_policy: backfill_ingest is never genuine forward evidence

canonical_url_normalization.scheme: lowercase; http and https normalized to https
canonical_url_normalization.path: remove trailing slash except root; preserve remaining path
canonical_url_normalization.query: drop fragment; remove tracking parameters beginning utm_ plus fbclid,gclid,mc_cid,mc_eid; sort remaining key/value pairs

source_admission.secondary_unique_match_policy: inherit prior identity only when exactly one historical match exists
source_admission.same_batch_collision_policy: all colliding new keys are identity_ambiguous independent of processing order
source_admission.rekey_policy: canonical or unique secondary match to prior source => rekeyed_duplicate and inherit prior first_fetched_at, ingest_type and admission provenance
source_admission.late_discovery_policy: high-confidence publication timestamp is veto-only; late discovery cannot be genuine forward
source_admission.backfill_policy: backfill and recovered historical sources are never genuine forward
source_admission.eventscore_policy: point-in-time eligible requires admission_class genuine_forward, immutable first-observation provenance, first_fetched_at at/after Evidence Foundation start, and baseline_timestamp_utc strictly after first_fetched_at

change_policy.post_freeze_exception: Only a demonstrated evidence-contamination or integrity defect may justify a future Evaluation Spec change. It must use a reviewed PR plus evidence-lock update; already accumulated forward evidence remains archived under its original Spec and cannot be mixed with a later Spec.

promotion_activation.reason: Spec 1.7 is the final pre-forward source-admission freeze; all prior statistical thresholds remain unchanged.
